guard: The commit that files a migration: refused when inadmissible, records who applied it, carries what the check found, and computes the target hash rather than taking the caller word for it.
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config implementations/runtime/smoke/mutations/migration-commit.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd

mutations.name: an inadmissible report is committed anyway
mutations.expectRed: committing it is refused BEFORE anything is written
mutations.cell: committing it is refused BEFORE anything is written

mutations.name: the commit files the report but never records who applied it
mutations.find: await markRunMigrationApplied(kv, endpoint, report.run, migrationId, driver, report.at);
mutations.expectRed: the APPLICATION is a separate fact naming the driver that made it
mutations.cell: the APPLICATION is a separate fact naming the driver that made it

mutations.name: the filed record drops the orphan rows
mutations.expectRed: including the orphan rows, so a reader is never told the work did not happen
mutations.cell: including the orphan rows, so a reader is never told the work did not happen

mutations.name: the target hash is the caller's claim rather than computed
mutations.expectRed: it carries the hash of the source it would move TO, computed rather than claimed
mutations.cell: and it carries the hash of the source it would move TO, computed rather than claimed

mutations.name: fromHash is invented from the new source instead of left absent
mutations.expectRed: while fromHash is carried as the caller's claim, because nothing here pins one
mutations.cell: while fromHash is carried as the caller's claim, because nothing here pins one

mutations.name: the walk's `branch missing` refusal is not translated into the report
mutations.find: } else if (e instanceof UnwalkableScope || e instanceof ScopeBranchMissing) {
mutations.expectRed: and the missing branch is reported, not consumed
mutations.cell: and the missing branch is reported, not consumed
mutations.note: The half a lang-side cell cannot see. The THROW is asserted in migrate.smoke; what nothing watched was this file TRANSLATING it into `unwalkable`, and an untranslated one falls through to the rethrow and reaches the caller as a raw exception instead of a report. The seat's earlier finding on this suite was exactly a translation branch nothing watched.
